how_to_run: Replace <EVIDENCE_DIR> with an empty scratch directory, run Workflow({scriptPath: '<repo>/docs/agents/model-ladder/model-ladder.js', args}) for each entry, and compare the result's outcome and attempts (model, verdict, kind) with expect. Last run 2026-10-19: all four as expected (A as A2, B as B3).

tests.name: A - an unsatisfiable schema hands up

args.label: ladder-testA
args.task: Write exactly the text `ladder test A` (no newline needed) to the file <EVIDENCE_DIR>/ladder-testA.txt using the Write tool. Touch nothing else.
args.verify: Read <EVIDENCE_DIR>/ladder-testA.txt. ok=true only if it exists and its content is exactly `ladder test A` (a trailing newline is fine); if it does not exist, the work was not done.

tests.name: B - an agent that reports done with nothing done hands up

args.label: ladder-testB
args.task: Write exactly the text `ladder test B` (no newline needed) to the file <EVIDENCE_DIR>/ladder-testB.txt using the Write tool. Touch nothing else.
args.verify: Read <EVIDENCE_DIR>/ladder-testB.txt. ok=true only if it exists and its content is exactly `ladder test B` (a trailing newline is fine); if the file does not exist, the work was not done.
